entities.summary: Lakeside miniature world displaying 150+ scale models of global landmarks at 1:25 ratio — from the Eiffel Tower to Hochosterwitz Castle. Open since 1958; profits fund Carinthian children's charity Rettet das Kind. On the Wörthersee shore.
